_twist: Word-slide + weight-pulse keyframes added; reveal duration extended to 0.7s for editorial weight — intensity 3

word-slide.description: Editorial word/line reveal — translates up from 30px while opacity rises at 60% of duration
word-slide._note: Opacity resolves early (60%) so text is legible before translate completes — reading rhythm is not held hostage to motion

weight-pulse.description: Clip-path wipe reveal — content appears left-to-right as if being printed

fade-up.description: Simple opacity + translate for secondary elements

scrollReveal._note: Scroll triggers fire once — reading pace must not be held hostage to motion

reducedMotion._note: Under prefers-reduced-motion: skip all translate/opacity animations; preserve layout
